#         the right code and then OVERWRITES it --
#           er.code = WALLET_RPC_ERROR_CODE_UNKNOWN_ERROR;
#           er.message = "Failed to open wallet : " + er.message;
#         (src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server.cpp:3705-3712) -- so it arrives as -1, which §1b.4 maps to

#         BEFORE that overwrite and keep their own exits (4 backend). fmonero pre-checks that
#         <wallet.dir>/<NAME>.keys exists (exit 6) so the surviving -1 is unambiguous.
#         Reach any of them from the mock with --fail open_wallet=-1:'Failed to open wallet : ...'

#         round-tripping it, so the mock never sees one.
